appearance.title: Appearance

membership.noCohortIsOpenToAdmissions: No cohort is open to admissions. Create one on the web dashboard first.
membership.scheduleTheFourSessionsAndAdmit: Schedule the four sessions and admit people from the interest pool once the cohort exists.
